name: Recovery Mango RSO Gummies 10-pack
description: RSO Gummies are made using the highest quality, full spectrum cannabis oil that is encapsulated using nano-technology. Not only does the encapsulation process make these gummies fast acting, it also improves the oil's taste. The Recovery formula is Sativa enhanced with a mango flavor and contains THC, CBD, CBG, CBC and CBN to help promote a speedy recovery of the mind and body. Activation time is 5-15 minutes.
